skillName: Slope Criteria for Parallel and Perpendicular Lines
intro: Slope tells us about parallel and perpendicular lines. The slope between $(x_1,y_1)$ and $(x_2,y_2)$ is $\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$. Two non-vertical lines are parallel exactly when their slopes are equal. They are perpendicular exactly when their slopes are negative reciprocals, meaning the product of the slopes is $-1$. For example, a line of slope $2$ is perpendicular to a line of slope $-\frac{1}{2}$.
